Two categories of missing fact needed DIFFERENT treatment. (1) STRUCTURAL/DIMENSIONAL specs (construction type, clear height, dock/drive-in count, per-building SF) do not change on their own between the 2026-06-09 freeze date and the later source documents (weeks-to-months apart, not decades) -- CORRECTED 2026-08-14 per REFUTE finding F5: the original wording said these are usable from 'any point in time,' which overstated the theory (a 1966-built structure's ORIGINAL dimensions are stable, but the building itself is not immune to renovation/demolition/addition over 60 years -- the real invariance claim is only that nothing material changed in the narrow freeze-to-source window, which is a much safer claim and the one actually relied on here). This narrower framing does NOT extend to CONDITION (Product & Physical's construction-and-condition sub-score) -- condition genuinely can change even over weeks, so scoring uses ONLY the pre-6/9-admissible structural-condition finding (see inputs.structural_condition), never the later OM's own condition claims. It also does not extend to a rail spur being described as 'active' -- the named railroad ceased operating in 1976, so 'active [railroad name withheld] rail spur' in the sourced OM is almost certainly stale boilerplate language carried across years of re-listings, not a verified current-as-of-freeze-date fact; carried in inputs.physical.docks_drive_ins as a physical-infrastructure detail (the spur's physical presence), not as evidence the spur was in active use at 6/9. (2) TENANCY/OCCUPANCY is explicitly a genuine UNKNOWN at 6/9 (ORA's own DD-Critical status said 'rent roll unreconciled' through the freeze date, corroborated by pre-6/9 Morning Brief pages) -- this is NOT a research gap to backfill, it is an irreducible fact of this deal's history. Later occupancy data exists (a Crexi listing's per-building tenant mix, and a later ~83% vacant portfolio-wide figure) but using it would import hindsight into a frozen pre-Phase-II snapshot, so it is deliberately excluded. Tenancy & Lease therefore stays null -- this is why confidence is MEDIUM, not HIGH: 6 of 7 categories are now resolved, but the 7th is structurally unresolvable without breaking the frozen-snapshot discipline, not merely under-researched.
